name: Cisco ASA — SMB Share Enumeration
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = cisco_asa_raw
| filter cisco_asa_raw._raw_log contains "302013" and xdm.source.port = 445
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count_distinct(xdm.source.ipv4) as distinct_hosts,
       values(xdm.source.ipv4) as source_hosts
       by xdm.target.ipv4, _time
| filter distinct_hosts >= 10
| alter initiator_ip = xdm.target.ipv4
| join type = left (
    dataset = cisco_asa_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "722051" and _raw_log contains "assigned to session"
    | alter pool_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Address <(\d+\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+)>"), 0),
            vpn_user = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "User <([^>]+)>"), 0)
    | filter pool_ip != null
    | comp values(vpn_user) as vpn_user by pool_ip
    | fields pool_ip, vpn_user
  ) as vbind vbind.pool_ip = initiator_ip
| join type = left (
    dataset = microsoft_windows_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "4624" and _raw_log contains "IpAddress"
    | alter logon_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='IpAddress'>([\d\.]+)<"), 0),
            ad_user  = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='TargetUserName'>([^<]+)<"), 0)
    | filter logon_ip != null and ad_user != null
    | comp values(ad_user) as ad_user by logon_ip
    | fields logon_ip, ad_user
  ) as wbind wbind.logon_ip = initiator_ip
| alter uname = coalesce(arrayindex(vpn_user, 0), arrayindex(ad_user, 0)),
        src_list = arraystring(source_hosts, ",")
| comp values(uname) as user_name, values(src_list) as source_hosts, max(distinct_hosts) as distinct_hosts by xdm.target.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.target.ipv4, source_hosts, user_name
description: One internal host establishing SMB sessions to many distinct internal hosts — share enumeration.
